name: suede-deslop
description: Suede Slop Stop: Suede Labs context-aware anti-slop pass for finished prose. Find or remove generic filler, manufactured emphasis, false agency, formulaic structure, chat and draft residue, and formatting applied by rule, without flattening the author's voice. Use before copy, a README, an email, a social post, or a doc ships; after a long assisted-writing session; or for a findings-only slop audit.
